board: M5Stack Unit Joystick (SKU U024, ATmega328, I2C 0x52, HY2.0-4P Grove port)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico in the first run. The model reads 3 bytes from address 0x52 (X 0-255, Y 0-255, button where 1 means pressed), taken from M5Stack's protocol table, the U024 sheet and M5Stack's own Arduino and UiFlow2 drivers. The unit is powered from 5 V and has no I2C pull-ups of its own, so the bus is pulled up to 3.3 V by the board.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://docs.m5stack.com/en/unit/joystick (PinMap: Black GND, Red 5V, Yellow SDA, White SCL) and schematic https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/joystick/joystick_sch_01.webp
